description: Create a model element AND its visual View on a diagram in one call. Use for populating native typed diagrams (UMLUseCaseDiagram, UMLActivityDiagram, UMLClassDiagram, etc.). Type examples: 'UMLActor', 'UMLUseCase', 'UMLAction', 'UMLInitialNode', 'UMLFinalNode', 'UMLDecisionNode', 'UMLClass', 'UMLComponent', 'UMLNode'. Returns view._id (for edge connections) and model._id. Requires staruml-mcp-extension to be installed in StarUML. Install from https://github.com/ezrabrilliant/staruml-mcp-extension

parentId.description: Owning model's _id (usually a UMLModel or UMLPackage)

name: create_element_with_view
